exactness_note: Rebuilds are intended to recreate equivalent CodeQL databases from the same source roots, CodeQL CLI version, and recorded database-create commands. Byte-for-byte identity is not guaranteed by CodeQL because database metadata, timestamps, logs, absolute paths, and build nondeterminism may differ.
restore_preconditions: Run v2_experiments/scripts/restore_source_environment.sh first if any source root is missing.
Use CodeQL CLI 2.23.5 from /opt/codeql or an equivalent distribution.
Keep the workspace at the same absolute path for the recorded original commands.
